in_marathi.name: Haimavathi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of the Snow Mountains
in_marathi.long_meaning: Haimavathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Haimavathi originated from the Sanskrit language and is derived from the words 'Haima' which means snow and 'Vathi' which means river. Haimavathi is the name of the Goddess of the snow-covered mountains. She is also known as Hemavathi, Haimavati or Haimavat. In Hindu mythology, Haimavathi is considered to be the wife of the sage Gautama and is the mother of the sage Parashurama.
